messages:
anya: Quick update — KV-prefix caching + adaptive batching landed on prod for small/medium models. Measured improvement: median token latency down ~18%, p99 down ~32%, token cost down ~22% on steady-state traffic. Canary at 10% now, aim to roll to 100% next Tue.

sanjay: Awesome. Can you drop the before/after numbers and which models/seq lengths? Also which rollout % is currently live?

anya: Current canary is 10% of requests for redwood-7b and redwood-13b. Seq distribution focused at 128–512.
Before/after (13b @seq512): p50 95ms -> 78ms, p99 419ms -> 285ms.
Token unit cost (1M tokens): $23.10 -> $18.00. Data from perf-run 2026-03-20.

kevin: I ran the bench script locally against the canary pool, results below.

kevin:```
$ bench_batching --model redwood-13b --seq 512 --concurrency 32
Before: avg_latency=95.3ms p99=418.7ms tokens_per_sec=620
After:  avg_latency=77.9ms p99=284.9ms tokens_per_sec=790
```

kevin: GPU util went up ~8% on avg, but tokens/sec improved enough that cost per token dropped. No extra OOMs observed in 48h canary.

maria: Any changes to fallback policies? We don't want batching to increase tail errors or hurt correctness sampling.

anya: No changes to model fallback. We added a safety bypass: if queue wait >300ms the request bypasses batching and is served immediately. Also hooked up response sampling for quality regressions (running evals on a seed set every hour).

perf-bot: deploy-monitor: Canary stable for 48h, error rate unchanged (<0.02%), latency p99 reduced 32% vs baseline, rollout health: PASS.

sanjay: Nice work :tada: Please add a short blurb to #product-announcements and update the runbook with the bypass threshold. Also can we add a per-route toggle in Console for teams that want to opt out?

anya: Adding Console toggle to our backlog. Filed INF-2487 with the key details: https://git.redwood.com/issue/INF-2487

kevin: I'll drop a short benchmark doc with graphs and the raw bench logs in eng-runtime later today. Happy to pair with infra on observability alerts.

maria: Thanks team — let's watch the first 24h after 100% rollout closely. Ping me if any anomalies. 

anya: Will do. Thanks all! :rocket:
